maria_cs: Quick check-in on AsterHealth onboarding — heads up: we're seeing sustained 98.4% uptime last 24h (their contract SLO is 99.5%). Can we triage fast and outline potential credit exposure? @rowan_sre @eli_ops
Rowan: digging in now. Quick glance shows a burst of 503s around 03:20 UTC that looks like an autoscale lag + cold pool. I have metrics open.
eli_ops: FYI their dedicated pool burst buffer is set low (1x). I can bump to 2x for the next 2 hours to soak traffic — want me to apply?
maria_cs: yes please apply. Also we need exact incident window and evidence for the customer SLO report + any credit calc.
rowan_sre: timeline so far: 03:17–03:26 UTC, ~240 failed requests, p95 latency spiked to 1.8s during the window. Quick log snippet: ```503 | pool-driver | scale-miss | txid=abcd1234 | host=node-17```
eli_ops: scaled pool up at 03:22, warmup running. Recommend running a prefix warm cache for their top prefixes while we stabilise: `scripts/warmup.sh --customer aster --top=50`
katie_pdm: Heads-up — renewal call is next Tue. If we present a clear timeline + remediation and offer a modest credit, it will materially reduce churn risk. Suggest we prepare the one-pager. :thumbsup:
jamal_csm: Can someone own a customer-facing one-pager (timeline, root cause, steps taken, credit calc)? Need a draft by EOD to share with Aster.
rowan_sre: I'll assemble the incident timeline + Grafana panels. Also adding traces to the incident folder. cc @alerts-bot for the audit link.
alerts-bot: Incident logged: INC-2026-1023 — audit logs and traces uploaded: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-1023
maria_cs: Capturing customer feedback too — they noted "slower responses during peak" in yesterday's enablement workshop. I'll include verbatim notes in the packet. Jamal, can you lead the narrative?
jamal_csm: On it. Also need the exact credit calc inputs: failed request count, avg tokens per request, and contractual multiplier. Row/Eli can you confirm numbers we should use?
eli_ops: Quick calc: 240 failed requests * avg payload 300 tokens = 72,000 tokens. At $0.0004/token => $28.8. Per contract credit multiplier is 3x => $86.40. I'll validate against billing records and formalize the number.
rowan_sre: Uploaded panel snapshots + raw traces to GDrive: https://gdrive.redwood/aster/INC-2026-1023 — includes p95/p99, request histogram, and host logs.
maria_cs: Thanks folks. Next steps: Rowan to post timeline + logs, Eli to formalize credit calc and billing evidence, Jamal to draft the one-pager, Katie to align renewal messaging. Reconvene 4:00pm PT to finalize customer comms. @everyone please add any blockers. 
eli_ops: ack — I'll have the calc and the warmup command results before 3pm PT.
rowan_sre: ack, timeline + screenshots by 2:30pm PT.
jamal_csm: ack, drafting now, will share an outline in this thread in 60m.
katie_pdm: I'll prep renewal note and suggested concession language for the call.
maria_cs: perfect — thanks all.
